name: SaneBox
tagline: SaneBox is an AI email management service that analyses your email behaviour and automatically sorts incoming messages into folders — SaneLater, SaneBlackHole, SaneNews — so your inbox only contains what needs your attention today. It works with any email client via IMAP and takes less than a minute to set up. Professionals drowning in newsletters and FYI threads use SaneBox to regain inbox focus.
